title: Kagamine Len — Heartfelt Performance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm back in my own SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Aww...
But things were just getting good.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I've been wanting to meet you for the longest time! You're such a great guitarist, you're mature and you're so cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cool? Me...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You were just having guitar practice, right? It's super cool how you're trying to pull everyone forward through your singing and playing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I also need to do better!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm cool?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: To be fair, I really appreciate him saying that since I want to do my best to keep being cool.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And he's basically me! That just makes me feel even happier inside...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I bet he's watching me right now. So, I'm gonna do my best to put on a really amazing show for the girls!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, Len, there you are...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Were you guys looking for me?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes...
The girls just brought some ice cream over for us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We were talking about having it together, but you'd disappeared from the classroom we were practicing in...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right. Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(It was that fragment.
It sent me over to that strange SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did something good happen just now, Len...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Sort of...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why'd you go wandering off like that, Len?! What's the big idea?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If we don't hurry, the ice cream Ichi and the others brought over is all gonna melt!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm sorry.
I was just getting some fresh air.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But, you guys could've just started without me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, that'd be like us leaving you out on purpose! We wouldn't do anything so mean!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right! In that case, thanks!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're all here, let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What choices do we have?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
They're all popsicles.
You apparently get a free one if you draw one with a stick that says, “You win!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. I bet I know who chose these for us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You get a free popsicle if you draw the right one! How fun and exciting is that♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I had to be Saki. She'd want to bring us treats that involve some sort of game.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wait a second. The girls brought these over for us, right? Where are they now?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: They immediately went back because they're practicing at the studio today...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay.
I guess they're still hard at it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That means we also need to do our best.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Since I'm gonna be on vocals for this show, I need to put on a really cool performance for them.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Not just for the girls. For that other me as well, who's watching over us.)
